hero.title: Future-Ready IT Programs for Schools & Colleges
hero.subtitle: Aptech Learning Whitefield partners with schools and colleges across Bangalore to deliver hands-on technology education — from coding for kids to campus placement readiness for final-year students.

schoolPrograms.title: Coding for Kids (Age 8–14)
schoolPrograms.desc: Fun, project-based coding using Scratch, Python basics, and game development. Builds logical thinking and creativity.

schoolPrograms.title: AI & Robotics for Schools
schoolPrograms.desc: Hands-on introduction to Artificial Intelligence concepts, basic robotics, and automation using age-appropriate tools.

schoolPrograms.title: Python Programming
schoolPrograms.desc: Structured Python course aligned with school curriculum. Covers variables, loops, functions, and mini-projects.

schoolPrograms.title: Holiday Tech Camps
schoolPrograms.desc: Intensive 5–10 day holiday camps covering Web Design, App Development, Digital Art, and Game Creation.

schoolPrograms.title: Digital Literacy Program
schoolPrograms.desc: Foundational digital skills — MS Office, internet safety, email etiquette, and basic computer operations.

schoolPrograms.title: Cybersecurity Awareness
schoolPrograms.desc: Age-appropriate cybersecurity education — online safety, password hygiene, phishing awareness, and responsible internet use.

collegePrograms.title: Campus Placement Readiness
collegePrograms.desc: Comprehensive placement preparation — aptitude, technical rounds, group discussions, and HR interview training.

collegePrograms.title: Final Year Project Support
collegePrograms.desc: Guided project development in AI, Data Science, Web Development, and IoT. Includes documentation and presentation coaching.

collegePrograms.title: Industry Workshops
collegePrograms.desc: One-day and two-day workshops on trending topics — Generative AI, Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity, and Data Analytics.

collegePrograms.title: Internship Programs
collegePrograms.desc: Structured internship programs with real-world projects, mentorship, and a certificate of completion from Aptech Learning.

collegePrograms.title: Add-On Certification Courses
collegePrograms.desc: Semester-break intensive courses in Python, Full Stack, Data Science, and Digital Marketing to boost employability.

collegePrograms.title: MoU & Partnership Programs
collegePrograms.desc: Formal MoU with colleges for ongoing curriculum integration, guest lectures, lab sessions, and joint certification.

benefits.title: Aptech Certified Programs
benefits.desc: All programs carry globally recognized Aptech Learning certification, adding value to student portfolios.

benefits.title: Expert Instructors
benefits.desc: Industry professionals with teaching experience deliver every session — engaging, practical, and curriculum-aligned.

benefits.title: Flexible Scheduling
benefits.desc: Programs designed around school/college timetables — after school, weekends, or during holidays and semester breaks.

benefits.title: On-Campus Delivery
benefits.desc: We come to your institution. No travel required for students — training delivered in your own labs or classrooms.

benefits.title: Hands-on Learning
benefits.desc: Every program is project-based. Students build real things — apps, websites, data models — not just theory.

benefits.title: Placement Support
benefits.desc: College students get access to our placement network and hiring partners upon course completion.

faqs.q: Can programs be conducted at our school/college campus?
faqs.a: Yes! We offer on-campus delivery anywhere in Bangalore. We bring instructors, materials, and coordinate with your IT lab.

faqs.q: What is the minimum batch size?
faqs.a: We can run programs for batches as small as 15 students. For larger batches, we can deploy multiple instructors simultaneously.
Yes, all students receive Aptech Learning certificates upon successful completion, which are globally recognized.

faqs.q: Can the curriculum be aligned with our board/university syllabus?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We customize content to complement your existing curriculum and can align with CBSE, ICSE, or university requirements.

faqs.q: How do we initiate a partnership?
faqs.a: Simply fill the enquiry form or call us. We'll schedule a meeting with your principal/HOD, understand your needs, and present a tailored proposal within 48 hours.
